purpose: F017 test-side confirmation — LiDAR vs camera row heading on held-out test anchor frames.
method: Ouster /os_cloud_node/points -> base_link -> trunk band (0.2<Z<1.2 m) -> robust per-side line fit -> centreline slope; camera heading = mean across 9 CP-6 models.
conclusion: Both sensors measure a nonzero tilt of the same sign on held-out test frames (LiDAR +3.04, camera +2.74, agree within 0.31 deg); sensor-commonality (F017) replicates. Both lower than val (LiDAR 3.84 / camera 3.25) - consistent with F019's scene-dependent per-pass tilt component.
